title: incident-bot: enrich on-call context & autodx attachments for SLO toolkit
author: Asha Menon
description: Motivation: improve on-call signal quality and shorten mean-time-to-diagnostics by enriching incident-bot automated diagnostics attachments and the SLO toolkit runbook links with additional on-call context. This PR adds: 1) richer on-call context payload (team, rotation, oncall-ttl, recent-ack-history) to Slack/Email autodx attachments; 2) automatic linking of matching runbooks from the SLO toolkit based on new SLO metadata tags; 3) a deduplication step to avoid noisy duplicate autodx postings for the same SLO event; 4) small UX improvements to the on-call helper command ("/oncall whois") to show active incident summaries. All description text is a single continuous string to preserve GitHub PR body norms. See commits and changed files for details. Related: ENG-4926 (autodiagnostics reliability), SUP-7042 (customer report of noisy alerts).
